questions.stem: A triangle has sides $7\text{ cm}$, $24\text{ cm}$, and $25\text{ cm}$. Is it a right-angled triangle?

options.text: No, because the sides are not equal

questions.explanation: $7^2 + 24^2 = 49 + 576 = 625 = 25^2$. Since $a^2 + b^2 = c^2$, the triangle is right-angled.

questions.stem: Find the length of the diagonal of a rectangle with sides $6\text{ cm}$ and $8\text{ cm}$.
questions.explanation: The diagonal forms the hypotenuse of a right-angled triangle: $d = \sqrt{6^2 + 8^2} = \sqrt{36 + 64} = \sqrt{100} = 10\text{ cm}$.
